help.stdout:
usage: gnd export ilp [-h] --labels LABELS --target {popper,neutral} --out OUT
                      model

Write the learner-neutral ILP form (gnd-ilp/1) of MODEL and a class-mode label
manifest, plus the named adapter's rendering, into a new directory. Examples
are the manifest's populations; the learned predicate wrong/1 covers the
negative class. Prints the export digest, the SHA-256 of export.json. Exits 0
on success, 3 on an invalid manifest, model or population or a value the
export cannot render, 5 when a population fails to load, 11 when --out exists,
64 on a usage error, 66 on a missing input, 74 on a refused path.

positional arguments:
  model                 path to the model file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --labels LABELS       class-mode label manifest (gnd-labels/1)
  --target {popper,neutral}
                        learner adapter: popper (neutral form plus bk.pl,
                        exs.pl, bias.pl) or neutral
  --out OUT             new directory for the export
